# The arrival of a_usd_arrival_booked_to_the_directors_account.txt moved from
# 2026-08-13 to 2026-08-14, every split and figure the same, for
# `--strategy update`.
#
# A cost basis's date is part of it: it is when the currency arrived, and the
# day every reading of it as of a date turns on. So moving it is a change to
# the cost basis, and is refused as one, the refusal stating both dates.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_an_edit_may_move_the_split_that_sets_the_rate.py.
